annotation.bound_parties_text: The offences provision binds a pilot or any person in charge of the RPAS or the owner, any person who operates an RPAS, and RPAS operators.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A pilot or any person in charge of the RPAS or the owner thereof who operates, or causes to be operated or commits any other person to operate a RPAS
annotation.robot_provision_quote: THE CIVIL AVIATION (REMOTELY PILOTED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2020
